reason: My cell, my voicemail and the guys have handled the phone for years, and my customers know to leave a message. I'm not putting two thousand dollars down on a robot answering under my company name because a website says it works in Québec French.
objection: Two grand up front before I've seen it work for anybody like me. I have no idea if it really catches more jobs than my voicemail does, and if it sounds wrong to a customer in Laval, that's my name on it.
would_change_my_mind: Talking to two or three roofers or landscapers around Laval who have used it for a full season and can tell me how many jobs it got them, or a first month where I don't pay the setup unless it proves itself.
